Triage: lands in area:ux · domain:ui · Feature · priority:p2 · `pm:blocked` · size S; rationale: term (6) of the #36877 ruling (「A 一次抛多条原因逐行翻译」). The console lists every reason of a multi-reason refusal line by line. It takes the parent's p2.

`Blocked-by: #36877` is open. On unlock it goes to seat 5 zone o5-U.

repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Ca6EBDpTBZk8v46Jjv

Zone o5-U · corrected after the seat's L2 record 7181908508 (N5)

Note from the seat's contract-tier L2 on PR #37395 (#36877), finding S3, comment 7181155005: take each refusal's reason lines from `details.refusals`, not by splitting `userMessage`. The entry's closing line is NOT in `details.refusals`: it lives only on `userMessage`, as its last line, and on /data `userMessage` is cut at 500 characters, so a long refusal loses that closing line there. Render the `details.refusals` lines in order, then the closing line when `userMessage` still carries it.

MCP's side of the same wire shape is carried by #37416 (area:ai, under #36877).
